name: What are the transportation options for getting around South Florida attractions?

mainEntity.name: What are the transportation options for getting around South Florida attractions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigating South Florida attractions can be done through various transportation options. Personal vehicles are common, but public transport like Miami-Dade Transit's Metromover and Metrobus, or Brightline high-speed rail connecting Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and West Palm Beach, are also available. Ride-sharing services are widely used. When planning your travel, a process clarity point is that traffic can be significant, especially during peak hours or tourist seasons in areas like South Beach or Brickell, so always factor in extra travel time or consider public transport if available.
acceptedAnswer.description: Transportation options include personal vehicles, public transit (Metromover, Metrobus, Brightline), and ride-sharing. Factor in extra travel time due to potential traffic, especially during peak hours.
